$doc: Routing table for the `dispatch` skill. Yours to edit; workspace-install seeds it once and never overwrites it. Values are `provider/model` strings the target harness resolves — an ID and nothing else; how a model loads and what each request carries live in the connector and the harness model entry (see the skill's references/connectors.md). Every model listed must be loaded at >=32k context or the dispatch dies before reading its brief. Lookup is most-specific-first: agents -> roles -> default.
